title: Figures 16-17: Porous hydroxyapatite bone-like structure and bioceramic hip component
description: A grayscale close-up of a porous, sponge-like material is captioned "Figure 16. Hydroxyapatite Porous Bone-Like Structure After Commercial Processing". Below, a photo of a white dome-shaped ceramic cup is captioned "Figure 17. Bioceramic Used in Artificial Hip Replacement Component". The text discusses hydroxyapatite and alumina bioceramics.
